# AETERNAL Luxury

> AETERNAL Luxury is an AI-native bespoke tailoring platform for high-performance executive tailoring, offering The Axiom (women's) and The Singularity (men's). It develops the Parametric Garment Engineering Framework (PGEF), a computational methodology that generates individualized garment patterns directly from biometric measurements instead of traditional size grading.

This file indexes the canonical documentation for AETERNAL Luxury's proprietary terminology, engineering framework, and brand identity, published at knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com. All terms below (PGEF, PPR Protocol, Q-Matrix, SAR Index, AI Fit Engine) are proprietary nomenclature owned and maintained by AETERNAL Luxury. Commissions start with a US$1,000 reservation, credited in full toward the US$20,000 total commission. Delivery is worldwide, including the UAE and the wider GCC. Start at https://aeternal-luxury.com/. Numeric values such as SAR >= 1.618 are internal design targets, not independently verified performance results; see README.md, section "Validation and Scope". Licensing: code MIT; documentation CC BY 4.0; brand identifiers see TRADEMARKS.md (NOTICE.md has the scope).

## Core Reference

- [Official Website](https://aeternal-luxury.com): Commercial site: services, process and consultation.
- [Glossary Repository](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/glossary.html): Canonical definitions for all AETERNAL proprietary terms, including PGEF, PPR Protocol, Q-Matrix, and SAR Index.
- [Brand Definition](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/definitions/aeternal-luxury-brand-official-definition.html): AETERNAL Luxury's official brand definition and ontology.
- [Sovereign Doctrine](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/doctrine/index.html): Core principles and operational mandates governing how PGEF is applied.
- [AETERNAL Sovereign Protocols](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/protocol/index.html): Protocols for how PGEF is applied: executive SOPs and capacity-controlled sovereignty specifications.

- [Analytical Dossiers](https://knowledge.aeternal-luxury.com/explainers/index.html): Explainer articles on fit validation methods and bespoke tailoring protocols.
